563:t_004:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That body color... It seems they aren't being controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

563:t_004:2.en:
$$レド$$
「But the fact remains that they're coming after us.」

563:t_004:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「So we have no choice but to fight...」

563:t_004:4.en:
$$モニカ$$
「More gravity wave readings! This is...!」

563:t_005:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So all the $$バアル$$ have turned up at once, is that it?」

563:t_005:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ aren't $$バアル$$.」

563:t_005:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's the same thing. They're still an enemy of humanity, and that doesn't change.」

563:t_005:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's why I'm saying, it just takes time for them to understand us...」

563:t_005:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I just hope humanity isn't wiped out before then.」

563:t_005:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「That kid's hopeless. He's gone completely into down mode.」

563:t_005:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「That kind of thing... I passed it ages ago.」

563:t_005:11.en:
$$葵$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ and the $$宇宙怪獣$$ seem to see each other as enemies, too.」

563:t_005:12.en:
$$万丈$$
「At this rate, it'll turn into a three-way struggle, won't it?」

563:t_005:13.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「These back-to-back battles have worn us down badly. We'll use the situation to our advantage and fight here!」

563:t_005:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis...! The enemy is $$宇宙怪獣$$! Now is the time to show the power of the $$トップレス$$!」

563:t_005:15.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis...! The enemy is $$宇宙怪獣$$! Now is the time to show the power of the $$トップレス$$!」

563:t_005:16.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Big Sis...! The enemy is $$宇宙怪獣$$! Now is the time to show the power of the $$トップレス$$!」

563:t_005:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Leave that for later, $$ノノ$$. If you understand your own mission.」

563:t_005:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Our mission is to protect the Earth...! Right now, we stake everything on it!」

563:t_005:29.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Louder! Above all else, do what you're supposed to do!」

563:t_005:37.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(She's just like... $$ノノリリ$$...)

563:t_005:38.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(She's just like... $$ノノリリ$$...)

563:t_006:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's coming from the $$クォーター$$'s fold speaker!」

563:t_006:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「This Aimo... It's not just $$ランカ$$, $$シェリル$$ is singing it too...」

563:t_006:3.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Listen, $$バジュラ$$... to our song...)

563:t_006:4.en:
$$ランカ$$
(We're not your enemies... So please, stop fighting.)

563:t_006:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We're broadcasting the song at $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$'s request, but...」

563:t_006:7.en:
$$モニカ$$
「No change can be seen in the $$バジュラ$$'s movements.」

563:t_006:9.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Even so, I'll keep singing...)

563:t_006:10.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Believing that someday this song will reach the $$バジュラ$$...)

563:t_006:14.en:
$$アルト$$
(You two are trying to stop the fighting in your own way, aren't you...)

563:t_006:15.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The dimensional boundary line is warping...!」

563:t_006:16.en:
$$ボビー$$
「You mean it's separate from that pitch-black hole!?」

563:t_006:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are their two songs shaking the dimension...!」

563:t_007:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$バスター軍団$$!」

563:t_007:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$バスター軍団$$!」

563:t_007:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are they being chased by $$宇宙怪獣$$!?」

563:t_008:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「You shielded the $$バスター軍団$$!?」

563:t_008:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Do you really think that, $$ニコラ$$?」

563:t_008:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「These kids were born to fight $$宇宙怪獣$$, just like my $$ガンバスター$$ and everyone's $$バスターマシン$$s...」

563:t_008:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Nonsense. They're only machines, aren't they?」

563:t_008:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The real you can't possibly think that way.」

563:t_008:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ノノ$$ said that to ride a $$バスターマシン$$, you have to connect hearts with the machine.」

uncertain: 563:t_004:1/2/3: subjects supplied (they = Vajra, we); Gamlin's 'not controlled' referent taken as the Vajra's coloring
563:t_005:7: 'that kid' = Nicola (Mari to Asuka), 'he' from glossary gender; 'down mode' kept literal
563:t_005:10: Asuka's 'that kind of thing' = Nicola's state, read as sympathy question answer
563:t_005:17: 'your Big Sis' - Lal'C answering Nono's address
563:t_005:36-38: 'She's just like Nonoriri' - referent Noriko supplied
563:t_006:2: Aimo left as plain song title 'Aimo'; t_006:1 'fold speaker' singular
563:t_006:17: Jeffrey's line rendered as an open question/realization ('Are their two songs shaking the dimension')
563:t_008:5: 消耗品 = 'expendables'; t_008:8 $$宇宙怪獣$$ plural token
